caseName: The Date She Never Returned From
title: Whitney & Callie

questions.text: I'm sorry, it's been 24 hours now and I'm already worried sick. How many people was she supposed to meet yesterday?
questions.hint: Check her calendar — the number of appointments should be recorded there.

questions.text: So, two people. I didn't know that. Sorry to keep asking, but could you tell me who the first one she was meant to see was?
questions.hint: It's the first event on the calendar — go take a look.

questions.text: A lesson. It doesn't seem like just an ordinary lesson though. What proves it was just a normal lesson?
questions.hint: Try checking Gmail for any correspondence between Callie and Trey.

questions.text: Alright, we know about Trey. But she had two back-to-back appointments. Who was the other person?
questions.hint: Look at the second appointment that day.

questions.text: I already told her straight up I didn't like him, turns out we'd met before. When they go away together, what kind of place do they book?
questions.hint: Open Messages and read the chat with Cole, looking for what he asks about the place he booked.

questions.text: Hm... they're not a couple, she'd have told me. So what is he really to her?
questions.hint: They're meeting in love hotel rooms without being a couple — draw your own conclusion.

questions.text: So that's what she was hiding from me. Fine... Maybe it's nothing, but something felt off in the days before she left. What odd thing did he ask her to do?
questions.hint: There's an odd request buried somewhere in their messages.

onboarding.text: Hey... A friend of mine gave me your name. She says you can dig, you can piece things together, and you notice what everyone else walks straight past. I need exactly that right now, and I don't have time.
onboarding.label: Whitney

onboarding.text: Callie and I go back to high school — she's the closest friend I have. We speak every day without fail, not one exception. Her phone is glued to her hand and an answer comes back within seconds
onboarding.label: Whitney & Callie

onboarding.text: Then a day of silence. Not a message, not a call, nothing to say she's alive. No likes, no stories, nothing. The police keep telling me to sit tight, that people do this... She doesn't. Three days is not her, not ever!!
onboarding.label: Whitney

onboarding.text: She said she had something on that afternoon and she'd tell me all about it that night. She didn't. I'm so scared. I've got her passwords — please, just start.
onboarding.label: Whitney

notes.title: A.
notes.body:
so he called and just... said it. that he's caught feelings for me.
now i don't even know what i'm supposed to feel

does part of me feel it back?

reasons to say yes:
- he cracks me up every single time
- i can tell him literally anything
- he just gets it, i never have to spell things out
- that weekend we spent together was honestly incredible 👀
- ok fine, he's hot

reasons to run:
- whitney has no idea we're even a thing, she's gonna lose it
- there's someone new i want to get to know
- being single is genuinely so good right now
- he was a mess with his ex, like actually a mess
- he's hit her before
